messages:
jamie: rolling out slice-4 -> prod in ~10m, canary at 5% then 25%. model tag model-v3-q8. doing short post-deploy checks. @alex @priya can you watch latency + errors? I'll kick the smoke script when traffic shifts :eyes:
alex: on it. I’ll monitor p50/p95 and 5xx on the infra dashboard. pinged grafana alert channel. :thumbsup:
priya: I can run smoke prompts and a few evals once canary is live. will focus on long-context and tokenization cases.
ops-bot: deploy-manager: slice-4 canary rollout scheduled, stage=canary, target=5%, started_by=jamie
jamie: canary is up at 5% (10:12). warming KV cache and prefixes now. running quick curl smoke:```bash
./scripts/smoke_short.sh --endpoint https://api.redwood.test/generate --n=20
# or quick curl:
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.test/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello world","max_tokens":20}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'
```
chao: seeing a ~40ms bump in p50 on canary nodes across a few zones, p95 unchanged, no increase in 5xx yet. correlating with kernel-level lib change from the compile job.
maria: logs show a handful of tokenizer WARN lines in worker-7; not 5xx. saving sample: /var/logs/prod/worker-7/tokenizer-warn-273501.log
aj: (typo) alex: we have grafana panels: infra/llm-latency and infra/error-rate; I added a 5m alert threshold at 0.1% 5xx
priya: smoke prompts: 20/22 passed. failing 2 cases both related to long-context truncation. opened PR #5678 with failing prompt + reproduction steps and tagged @codeowners and @alex for review. :memo:
jamie: good catch. if 5xx > 0.1% or quality regressions > 5% revert plan: rollback-lite -> shift traffic back to model-v3-fp16 and drain slice-4. Rollback runbook: /runbooks/rollback-lite.md
alex: currently 5xx = 0.02% over last 5m, p95 stable, continuing watch. canary -> 25% in 5m.
ops-bot: deploy-manager: canary traffic scaled to 25% (10:22)
chao: after scale, small additional p50 bump (~15ms) but no errors. looks like batching window changed slightly. not alarming.
priya: updated PR with logs and a suggested fix for tokenizer edge-case. posted diffs and test results. tagging for quick CR.
jamie: thanks — please @mention me in the PR comments. leaving watch for 30m. if anything crosses thresholds we revert slice or switch to fallback. :shipit: 
priya: will follow up with a small hotfix release if CR approved; otherwise we'll schedule a patch in the next maintenance window.
alex: noted. i'll mute noise alerts and leave only critical thresholds for the next 45m.
maria: saving collected samples and alerts to the incident bucket for postmortem notes (no incident expected): s3://redwood-prod/postdeploy/2735012345/
jamie: perfect. final check-in here in 30m. thanks team — good run.
